meta.title: makeicons — Icon generator
meta.description: Generate every icon your website needs from a single image. Everything runs in your browser.
language.label: Language
intro.title: Your icon, everywhere.
intro.subtitle: Generate all the icons your website needs.
upload.title: Drop your image here
upload.privacy: Everything is processed locally in your browser. Nothing is uploaded.
preview.title: Preview
warning.pixel: This is a pixel image (PNG, JPG or WebP): it may look blurry when enlarged. For the best quality use SVG, which stays sharp at any size.
warning.small: The shorter side is under 512 px: it will look blurry in the larger icons.
warning.opaque: It has no transparency: it is used as is, with its background, and the monochrome icon cannot be generated.
shape.title: Shape
background.title: Background
background.helper: Apple Touch Icon and Maskable icons require an opaque background. This background is also applied to other icons when enabled.
maskable.title: Maskable icons
maskable.marginHelper: The logo stays inside the dashed circle, which is never cropped. The rest is background. The circle is only a guide and is not downloaded.
maskable.coverWarning: The logo fills the whole square. The phone trims it into a circle or another shape, so its edges may be lost. Margin and corner radius do not apply.
dark.title: Dark mode
dark.noColors: No editable colors were detected in this SVG.
dark.colorsCapped: Only the first 8 colors are listed.
dark.logoHelper: Black, white and gray colors are inverted by default. Gradients and colors defined in <style> blocks are not detected.
dark.helper: Applies only to favicon.svg, in browsers that follow the system theme.
outputs.title: Generated files
files.head: <link> and <meta> tags
limits.title: Limitations
limits.png: PNG files exported from the browser are not compressed to the maximum and can weigh more than ones optimized with tools like pngquant or Squoosh.
limits.vector: A pixel image cannot be exported as a real SVG.
limits.jpg: JPG does not keep transparency; PNG and WebP do.
limits.font: Text in an SVG that uses a font not embedded in the file is drawn with a fallback font. Convert the text to paths (outlines) to keep it exact.
limits.monochrome: The monochrome icon is a black silhouette that the system can tint. It is part of the web manifest specification, but support is still limited.
